from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
p=Path('products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation')
b=Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/live-baseline.html').read_bytes()
v=json.loads((p/'offline-preview/verification.json').read_text())
i=(p/'offline-preview/index-preview.html').read_bytes()
e=(p/'offline-preview/worked-example-en-fr.md').read_bytes()
o,n=v['insertion_byte_offset'],v['insertion_bytes']
sha=lambda x:hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()
assert i[:o]+i[o+n:]==b and sha(b)==v['captured_live_sha256'] and sha(i)==v['preview_sha256'] and sha(e)==v['example_sha256']
assert i[o:o+n].count(b'href="worked-example-en-fr.md"')==2
print(i[o:o+n].decode())
d=json.loads((p/'director-diff.json').read_text())
for line in d['unified_diff'].splitlines():
 if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++'): print(line[:500])
print('Byte reversal, three hashes and both relative links passed.')
